judgment_text:
PRAYER : - To writ of mandamus, directing the 1 to 4th Respondents to permit the petitioner to participate in the festival of Punitha Sepastiar Alayam, Archerippu Vizha at East Thalirmarungur Village, Thinaiyathur Post, Thiruvadanai Taluka, Ramanathapuram District schedule to be held on 25-4-2026 by considering petitioner's representation dated 21-4-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

L. Victoria Gowri, J.:— This Writ Petition is filed seeking writ of mandamus, directing the 1 to 4th Respondents to permit the petitioner to participate in the festival of Punitha Sepastiar Alayam, Archerippu Vizha at East Thalirmarungur Village, Thinaiyathur Post, Thiruvadanai Taluka, Ramanathapuram District schedule to be held on 25-4-2026 by considering petitioner's representation dated 21-4-2026.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is prevented from participating in the said festival. Hence, the petitioner has made a representation dated 21-4-2026, against the private respondents who are preventing the petitioner from participating in the Archerippu Vizha at East Thalirmarungur Village, Thinaiyathur Post, Thiruvadanai Taluka, Ramanathapuram District. Since the same was not considered, seeking indulgence of this Court, this Writ Petition is filed.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the private respondents submitted that he is not at all a member of the said church. However, no one will prevent him from participating in a church festival and he is at liberty to offer as much donation as he is willing to.

4. The learned counsel the petitioner submitted that he belongs to the same village and hence he is obviously the member of the church. However, the rival parties are now claiming him to be a stranger.

5. Heard either sides and carefully perused the materials available on record.

6. Since there is a disputed question as to which village the petitioner hails from, the 4th respondent police is directed to issue summons on the petitioner as well as the 5th to 8th respondents under Section 64 BNSS and conduct an enquiry forthwith and resolve the dispute immediately, facilitating the petitioner to participate in the festival. It is made clear that the respondent police should see to that the petitioner and his people are not ex-communicated from participating in the church.

7. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs.
